summary: the forge's merge settings, and the merge that obeys them

gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}: reads the live settings, for the report and for sync
gh pr list --state all: reads every PR, for the branch roster the report and prune share
gh repo view: reads the default branch, when the base is not given
git remote prune --dry-run origin: asks the remote which tracking refs it has dropped
git fetch --quiet origin <branch>: reads this checkout's own upstream, for the checkout row

explanation.forge settings: the forge's merge settings, declared in src/main/cli/forge/forge.csv and compared row by row with what the forge holds for this checkout's remote; a drift carries corpus-yoga forge sync --apply as its remedy, and a forge not read says why under live
explanation.branches: each branch the forge or this clone holds, and whether it is kept or deletable - its work merged, or its PR superseded; corpus-yoga forge prune removes the deletable
explanation.remote-tracking refs: the refs this clone keeps for branches the forge has deleted; corpus-yoga forge prune drops the stale
explanation.this checkout: the branch the checkout is on against its upstream, and the commit hook, as corpus-yoga test says it
